id.description: Canonical OParl ID of the record, an absolute URL under the municipality's endpoint.

type.description: OParl type without the schema prefix: Meeting, Paper, Organization, Person, Location, AgendaItem, File, Draft.

name.description: Display name; for people the fullName.

start.description: Start as the server published it, usually ISO 8601 with offset. Only on meetings and agenda items.

end.description: End, same format, where the server publishes it.

public.description: Whether the record is public, where the server states it. Absent on many vendors.

location.description: Name of the linked location, resolved one level; the raw object keeps the link.

organizationIds.description: OParl IDs of the responsible organizations/committees.

participantIds.description: OParl IDs of the participants, where published.

license.description: License of the source system as its System object declares it; often missing.

sourceSystem.description: Name of the municipality's OParl system.

vendor.description: Vendor string of the source system, usually a repository URL. Useful for grouping by software.

fetchedAt.description: UTC timestamp of this fetch, ISO 8601.

raw.description: The untouched OParl object as the server returned it, including fields this Actor does not flatten (agendaItem, auxiliaryFile, consultation, web, created, modified).

_report.description: True on exactly one item per run: the capability fingerprint rather than a council record.

report.description: Measured facts about the endpoint: System metadata (name, vendor, licence, OParl version), and per collection the resolved URL, the paging mode proved by probing (page, offset or single_page) and the item count. A collection the endpoint does not offer appears with status not_available. Also carries items_total, the dataset-push receipt and the billing receipt. Environment variable names, SDK error text and the request log appear only when the input sets debug=true.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per record: what it is, when, where and which system it came from.

raw.title: Raw OParl object
raw.description: The untouched vendor object, for anything this Actor does not flatten.
